comment: UNMEASURED TEMPLATE. Measure nozzle outlet XYZ from physical-left optical centre in metres: camera X right, Y down, Z forward. R_camera_from_nozzle is a proper 3x3 rotation mapping nozzle axes into camera axes; its third column is the outgoing straight-jet unit direction. Verify current camera matrix against /vision/camera_info. Specify a measured minimum/maximum range, calibration ID and unchanged rigid-mount ID before setting nozzle_calibrated=true. This geometric reference compensates parallax and boresight only; it cannot enable pumping or certify water impact. Empirical landing compensation and geometric compensation are alternative absolute references and must never be added together. Re-measure after changing camera/nozzle mounting, and refresh stereo range while the gimbal moves. Pump pressure, water drop, spray and actuator backlash require actual landing calibration. Do not copy the synthetic unit-test offsets into hardware configuration.
